title: The Found Money Rule Rich People Follow — $340K
hook: You get a bonus or tax refund — and 90% of us blow it within 30 days. Here's what that costs you over a lifetime.
angle: The 'house money effect' makes your brain treat windfalls as fake money. The wealthy exploit a one-rule fix that turns $4,200/year in windfall cash into $340K.
audience: Anyone who gets a tax refund, work bonus, or cash gift and wonders where it went
key_numbers: 90% of windfall money is spent within 30 days
